tree.heading: Federal Charter.—
tree.text: Future Farmers of America (in this chapter, the “FFA”) is a federally chartered corporation.

tree.heading: Perpetual Existence.—
tree.text: Except as otherwise provided, the FFA has perpetual existence.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 7090136:271.Aug. 30, 1950, ch. 823, §§ 1, 2, 20, 64 Stat. 563, 567. 36:272. 36:290.
